name: Willfar Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Willfar Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides smart utility services and IoT solutions in China and internationally. The company offers EV charging station, power monitoring, data concentrator unit, integrated power solutions, communication module, energy efficient management, head-end system, smart vending solutions, and intelligent street lighting.
